featured.a: Kesteven Business Centre, Kesteven Street, Sleaford
featured.desc: Superfood cafe on the ground floor of Kesteven Business Centre: acai bowls, protein shakes, smoothies, coffee and matcha, protein salads and bakes. Walk in, order for delivery across Sleaford, or call for catering.

Serviced offices in Sleaford's old police station, 113 to 964 sq ft, from £250 a month all-inclusive, 6 to 12 month terms, parking behind. Meeting room for up to 12 from £15 an hour; private day office on enquiry.
